purpose: Qualify native USL snapshot preservation and bounded relational program induction before an independently controlled G0/G1 study.
conceptual_delta: A source-owned native graph is read once per USL request; exact native identity and observation bindings reach a pure TS learner which induces compositions of declared role traversals rather than only adjusting a fixed guard score.
external_system: Existing local USL connectUsl with injected owner read and resolver fixture; no live KG configuration, query or write.
task: From a changed component, select native check UIDs whose requirements concern affected artifacts in an authored maintenance catalog.

search.selection: A label error then AST node count; V selects among exact A ties with the same objective; stable canonical tie order is disclosed.

B.use: post-selection evaluation; branching, distractors, order and unused context-role shift within the same authored rule

A_retain.use: fresh instances of the original regime; no subsequent second-rule learning

outcome: Exact native UID set comparison against direct owner catalog table joins, not USL resourcesResolve, semanticTruth or a model-generated success label.

control_definitions.RAW_HISTORY_EXACT_UID_RECALL: Return the A label only for an exactly repeated focus UID, otherwise empty. Disjoint split UIDs make this an intentionally weak negative control, not raw-history reasoning, retrieval or a published agent baseline.
control_definitions.FIXED_ONE_HOP_LIBRARY: Best A/V-fitted program from Here and single declared hops; a restricted negative control.
control_definitions.NATIVE_INFORMATION_MATCHED_PROGRAM_INDUC: Same learner and complete semantic information. Equality is expected transport equivalence; inequality indicates an instrument/mapping issue. It is not an independent method comparison.

qualifications: An in-flight request retains the first native source, identities, meanings and report despite an owner change.
A later request reads the owner again; old independently supplied plan pins reject a changed plan; independently refreshed fixture pins accept it.
The induced AST uses a composition absent from the initial Here and one-hop library.
Native and USL views have equal information and use identical induction/selection and execution budgets.
Remove, restore and wrong-target arms are fixed before evaluation. No failed qualification is omitted.
unmet_confirmatory_requirements: Authored synthetic task and labels share an author/process; there is no independent outcome custodian or external chronology witness.
The test rule and primitive alphabet are supplied by the study author; this is composition inside a finite DSL, not new primitive or schema invention.
AST complexity above the seed library is syntactic novelty only; it is not a general semantic-equivalence proof.
B is mechanically excluded from fit/selection but not independently sealed or secret from the researcher.
No pinned frontier LLM proposer, native-agent baseline, published text-skill baseline, or independently implemented program-library baseline is run.
The candidate is a research record; it has no canonical Atom admission, independent causal credit or Permit effect.
A_retain measures same-regime reuse only, not catastrophic forgetting after a second learning phase.
Program executions and node steps are accounting instruments; they do not equal model tokens, FLOPs, or independent repeated runs.
stopping: One frozen protocol run after instrument tests. Instrument errors are retained as failed attempts; repair changes require a new source-bound attempt. No efficacy threshold tuning or statistical significance claim.
